summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and private helper _resolve_path; exported it from monai/data/__init__.py; added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection after the Utilities entry in docs/source/data.rst; added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, test_seg_no_labels). Nothing was run: tests, black, and flake8 are unverified, and Python 3.9 compatibility was checked by reading only. Lines were checked manually to be at most 120 columns. No commits were made.
